title: Source
label: Source of {{name}}
load.failed.title: Could not read the source of {{name}}
load.failed.body: The agent did not answer with it ({{code}}).
load.failed.unreadable: The agent's answer was not a workflow the Hub can read.
load.failed.paused: Agents on {{computer}} are paused. The source can be read when they resume.
project: Saving makes your own copy; the project's file is unchanged.
system: Saving makes your own changed copy. Reset to shipped brings the shipped version back.
problem.object: The source must be one JSON object.
problem.entry: The source needs an entry_point naming the first step.
problem.steps: The source needs at least one step.
problem.tooBig: The source is larger than 1 MB, more than the agent takes.
problem.unknownKey: "{{key}}" is not a workflow field, so the agent would refuse it.
problem.type: "{{key}}" has a value of the wrong kind, so the agent would refuse it.
problem.blankOutput: The output "{{key}}" needs a template; the agent refuses a blank one.
refused.paused: Agents on {{computer}} are paused, so nothing was saved. Save again after they resume.
refused: The agent did not save it ({{code}}). Nothing was written.
refused.unsent: The change was not sent ({{code}}). Nothing was written.
refused.invalidNoReason: Not saved: the definition is not valid.
unsure: The answer to this save was lost, or the agent answered an error after it may have written. It may have been saved. Nothing was sent again.
unsure.failed: The workflow could not be read. It may still have been saved.
unsure.same: The workflow still reads as it was before this save. The outcome is unknown; your text is kept. Stop tracking to edit the current version.
unsure.changed: The workflow does not read exactly as you sent it. The outcome is unknown; your text is kept. Stop tracking to edit the current version.
unsure.gone: The workflow is gone. Your text stays here.
abandon.title: Stop tracking this save?
abandon.body: Your text stays here and the next Save is checked against the workflow as last read. The earlier save may still land later.
stale: The saved workflow could not be read again, so the next save would not be checked. Reload it before saving.
conflict: The workflow changed on the computer since you opened it. Nothing was saved.
conflict.reading: Reading the workflow as it is now…
conflict.theirsFailed: The workflow could not be read ({{code}}).
conflict.theirsGone: The workflow is gone from the computer.
diff.title: How saving yours would change it
diff.same: Theirs and yours are the same. Keep mine, then Save.
reload.title: Drop your changes?
reload.body: Your text is replaced by the workflow as it is on the computer.
leave.title: Leave the source?
leave.body: Your changes to {{name}} are not saved.
leave.body.unsure: The last save of {{name}} may not have landed, and your text is only here.
danger.hideHint: Hidden workflows stay on the computer; the agent's own list and the terminal's Workflows tab leave them out.
danger.busyReason: Wait until the change in progress is settled.
source.busyReason: Wait until the save in progress is settled.
danger.delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
danger.delete.consequence1: Its source is gone; there is no undo.
danger.delete.consequence2: Anything that starts it by name will not find it.
danger.reset.title: Reset {{name}} to the shipped version?
danger.reset.body: Your changes to it are removed. In a realm of its own the version that comes with the agent is used again at once; in Global it comes back only when the agent restarts, and the workflow is missing from the list until then.
danger.done.reset: {{name}} is back to the shipped version.
danger.done.resetLater: Your changes to {{name}} are removed. The shipped version comes back when the agent on {{computer}} restarts; until then it is not in the list.
danger.done.resetUnread: Your changes to {{name}} are removed. The list does not show yet whether the shipped version is back.
danger.paused: Agents on {{computer}} are paused, so nothing was done. Try again after they resume.
danger.refused: The agent did not do it ({{code}}). Nothing was changed.
danger.unsure.delete: The answer was lost. {{name}} may have been deleted. Nothing was sent again.
danger.unsure.reset: The answer was lost. Your changes to {{name}} may have been removed. Nothing was sent again.
danger.unsure.hide: The answer was lost. It is not known whether {{name}} is hidden. Choosing again is safe: it sets the same thing.
danger.seenSame: It still reads as before. The change may still land.
danger.checkFailed: The result could not be read. It may still have happened.
forget.title: Stop tracking it?
forget.body: Nothing is sent. The earlier request may still land later.
closeAsk.body: Closing the source drops your text; the workflow stays as it is on the computer.
kept: Your edit was kept while you looked elsewhere. It is not saved yet.
